why: not simulatable: whether a ghost is at peace is not a state that any causal social or physical mechanism can produce, act on, or observe. The claims are sincere records of a death (e3), folklore (e4, e10), felt experiences (e2, e8), a practitioner's belief (e5), dispositions and stances (e7, e9), and a scheduled vigil (e6), but none supplies a mechanism linking any action to a spirit's condition, nor an observable criterion for being at peace, so no evidence-grounded world can be built that answers the question.
